## 1. Slice 1: Three.js Engine Lifecycle

### Confirmed bugs

| File:line | Severity | Category | Description | Fix sketch |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bindings/legend-bindings.js:36-50` | HIGH | listener | Two `document.addEventListener` calls (`pointerdown` line 36, `keydown` line 46) registered outside `AbortController` signal used by `global-bindings.js`. Never removed by `disposeEventListeners()`. Duplicate listeners accumulate on each deinit/reinit cycle. | Pass `{ signal: _globalEventController.signal }` as options arg, or explicitly store and remove in teardown. |
| `bindings/onboarding-bindings.js:49` | HIGH | listener | Three `document.addEventListener` calls (`mousemove`, `keydown`, `click`) registered outside `AbortController` signal. Call `resetOnboardingIdleTimer` creating recursive `setTimeout` chains. Never cleaned up by `disposeEventListeners()`. | Pass `AbortController` signal, or store handler refs for explicit teardown. |
| `three-search-animations.js:27,220-258` | HIGH | rAF | Module-level `_heroRafId` stores `requestAnimationFrame` handle from `triggerSearchHeroMoment()`. Never cancelled during engine teardown — `cancelAnimate()` in `three-engine.js` only cancels its own `_rafId`. If hero moment is mid-flight when `deinit()` runs, animation frame fires against nullified state. | Export `disposeHeroAnimation()` function, call from `three-engine.js` `deinit()`. |
| `bindings/panel-bindings.js:69` | MEDIUM | listener | `window.addEventListener('resize', _activeResizeHandler)` registered outside `AbortController` signal. Not removed on teardown by `disposeEventListeners()`. | Wrap in signal or add explicit remove call in teardown. |

## 2. Slice 2: State, Timer, Race-Condition

### Confirmed bugs

| File:line | Severity | Category | Description | Fix sketch |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `js/state.js:460-497` | HIGH | proxy | **Proxy bypass via sub-object mutation.** The Proxy `set` trap only intercepts top-level `state.*` assignments. 79+ instances of `state.navState.<prop> = <value>` reach `get` trap (returns raw `_rawState.navState`), then mutate raw object directly — bypassing `CRITICAL_KEYS` guard. | `get()` for `TRACKED_SUB_KEYS` should return nested Proxy (prod scope), or route all `navState` writes through `withStateMutation()`. |
| `js/state.js:395-396` | LOW | state | `strandContinuityState` default still declares `arrivalTimeoutId: undefined` / `settleTimeoutId: undefined`. Dead code — strand-continuity.js now uses Map-based `_timers`. | Remove unused fields from default state object. |

| AGENTS.md claim | Verdict | Source |
|---|---|---|

No `strandContinuityState.arrivalTimeoutId` writes found. | slice2 grep: `strandContinuityState\.(arrivalTimeoutId|settleTimeoutId)` → 0 matches |
| `journey-thread-settler race` | **Partially fixed** — `thread-inspector.js` now uses `setTimer()`/`clearTimer()` from strand-continuity (lines 312-432). `journey-thread-settler.js` uses its own `_threadTimers` Map via `timerAdapter`. Dual timer pools exist but both use Map-based tracking. | slice2 grep: `setTimer\|clearTimer\|disposeTimers` → 26 matches |
| `state.js Proxy bypass` | **Confirmed** at state.js:460-497 — 79+ unguarded sub-property writes. | slice2 grep: `state\.navState\.\w+\s*=` → 79 matches |
| `journey-compass-state.js` state machine | **Stale** — `getJourneyCompassState()` is a pure derivation function, not an FSM. No `idle -> checking -> synthesizing -> active` transitions exist in code. | slice2 grep: `idle.*checking.*synthesizing` → 0 matches |

## 3. Slice 3: CSS Cascade & Visual

### Confirmed bugs

| File:line | Severity | Category | Description | Fix sketch |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `css/mobile_premium__narrow.css:9-26` | LOW | scope-leak | `@media (max-width: 360px)` block has bare class selectors (`.stat-caption`, `.map-trail-strip`, `.map-strip-title`, `.info-panel-surface`) without `body.is-active` or `data-panel-surface` state gates. Applies overrides in ALL panel states at ≤360px. | Prefix with `body.is-active[data-panel-surface]` to match scoped journey-compass selectors in same block. |
| `css/mobile_premium__narrow.css:96-142` | MEDIUM | scope-leak | Escape-hatch `@media (min-width: 361px) and (max-width: 768px)` re-shows chrome for focus states. At ≤360px no escape-hatch applies — journey-compass hidden entirely (lines 71-73). Users on ≤360px in focus state have no chrome escape path. | Extend escape-hatch range to ≤360px, or add minimal escape affordance. |
| `css/modules/focus_stage.css:53` | LOW | z-index | Bare `z-index: 1` literal does not flow through managed `var(--z-*)` system. | Replace with `var(--z-field-nodes)` or appropriate token. |
| `css/search.css:576` | LOW | z-index | Bare `z-index: 0` literal does not flow through managed `var(--z-*)` system. | Replace with `var(--z-canvas)` or appropriate token. |

## 8. WIP Regression — lifecycle.js facade dropped DOM scaffold init

**Status:** Open — other editor WIP, contract audit 65 fails (59 caused by this)
**Date identified:** 2026-06-05
**Source:** Contract audit triage (`reports/contract-audit-triage-2026-06-05.md`)

### Diagnosis

The lifecycle.js refactor (net -217 lines, extracted to `lifecycle-modes.js`, `lifecycle-reset.js`, `lifecycle-search-sync.js`) decomposed the init pipeline but dropped DOM scaffold creation calls. Five missing init calls:

1. `ensureFocusStageAuxiliaryDom()` — creates `#focus-stage`, `#thread-inspector`, `.compass-rail`, `#mode-chips`
2. compass-rail builder (`.compass-step`, `.compass-steps`)
3. mode-chips renderer (`.mode-chip` elements)
4. camera-controls setup (`#camera-controls`, `#btn-journey-primary`, `#btn-journey-secondary`)
5. selected-card surface hydration (`#selected-card`, `#selected-empty`, `#selected-details`)

### Affected surfaces (13)

launch-focus, search-no-results, map-trail, focus-pocket, field-node, info-panel-empty, compass-rail, mode-grid, thread-inspector, controls, search-chrome, mobile-product-focus-route, mobile-product-preview-route

### Resolution path

Re-add the DOM scaffold init calls to the lifecycle.js facade (or ensure the extracted modules call them during boot). All 65 contract failures should resolve simultaneously.

### Reference

- Full report: `reports/contract-audit-triage-2026-06-05.md`
- HEAD `77f350e` is clean (0/65 failures attributable to it)
- Untracked WIP files: `lifecycle-modes.js`, `lifecycle-reset.js`, `lifecycle-search-sync.js`, `camera-controls-choreography-{cursor,focus,routes}.js`, `micro-demo-choreography.js`
